name: linear spring-dashpot elements
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 以线性刚度与黏性阻尼描述车辆悬挂等连接的单元。
usage_note: 采用线性等效的悬挂模型，不能代表实际悬挂始终线性。

complete_examples.text: In this model, the vehicle is regarded as a multi-rigid bodies sub system with a car body, two bogie frames and four wheelsets, each component is connected by suspension systems that are modeled as the linear spring-dashpot elements.
